g.text: Figure 8 (map). One backward step on the first road of Wondang-ri's route (315 m), 18:00 KST, 25 March 2025. Arriving at the

text.style: font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'NanumGothic'; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: far end by 18:22:42 still reaches a shelter; the drive takes 29 s; fire reaches the start of the road at 18:15:27. The leave-by time

text.style: font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'NanumGothic'; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: is the earlier limit, 18:15:21, set by the fire; it equals the village's leave-by time from the field.
